name: SSI2140
full_name: FatKeys Voltage Controlled Multi-Mode Filter (4-section OTA-based VCF)
description: Four independently-configurable variable-transconductance (gm) cells with temperature-compensated exponential control, designed by original SSM2040 designer Dave Rossum as its modern successor. Each cell can be wired as a filter pole; combine one to four for low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, all-pass, notch, Sallen-Key, biquad, Cauer, or state-variable responses. Includes an on-chip resonance VCA with linear current control for Q. Preserves the SSM2040's classic analog synth filter character (including an overdrivable input stage) while improving noise and gm production spread (1.7:1 vs the SSM2040's 3:1).

pins.name: OUT2
pins.description: output of transconductance cell 2's buffer amplifier; +-1V swing max, sources 10mA/sinks 1.6mA. Use 10k ohm or greater feedback/load resistors

pins.name: CAP2
pins.description: integrating capacitor pin for cell 2, to GND; use 50pF or greater for stability

pins.name: IN2
pins.description: inverting input to transconductance cell 2; recommended 10k input resistor with a 200 ohm attenuator to GND for best control rejection

pins.name: OUT1
pins.description: output of transconductance cell 1's buffer amplifier; same drive/swing limits as OUT2

pins.name: CAP1
pins.description: integrating capacitor pin for cell 1, to GND; use 50pF or greater for stability

pins.name: IN1
pins.description: inverting input to transconductance cell 1; same recommended input network as IN2

pins.name: EXPO CTRL
pins.description: exponential control voltage that sets the gain of all four transconductance cells together, typical sensitivity -18mV/octave

pins.name: TEMPCO
pins.description: internal 890 ohm (typ) temperature-compensating resistor; leave disconnected if unused

pins.name: Q VCA OUT
pins.description: output current of the Q (resonance) VCA; connect to ground if unused

pins.name: GND
pins.description: analog signal ground; use a short, low-inductance trace

pins.name: V-
pins.description: negative supply; recommend a 100nF local decoupling capacitor placed close to the package

pins.name: Q CTRL
pins.description: current control of Q VCA gain; ground-referenced current input

pins.name: Q VCA IN+
pins.description: noninverting input of the Q VCA; the inverting input is internally tied to OUT4

pins.name: OUT4
pins.description: output of transconductance cell 4's buffer amplifier; same drive/swing limits as OUT2

pins.name: CAP4
pins.description: integrating capacitor pin for cell 4, to GND; use 50pF or greater for stability

pins.name: IN4
pins.description: inverting input to transconductance cell 4; same recommended input network as IN2

pins.name: OUT3
pins.description: output of transconductance cell 3's buffer amplifier; same drive/swing limits as OUT2

pins.name: CAP3
pins.description: integrating capacitor pin for cell 3, to GND; use 50pF or greater for stability

pins.name: IN3
pins.description: inverting input to transconductance cell 3; same recommended input network as IN2

pins.name: V+
pins.description: positive supply; recommend a 100nF local decoupling capacitor placed close to the package

SSOP-20.notes: Per Sound Semiconductor's own connection diagram (Rev 3.1.1, March 2023), 20-lead SSOP, top view. Cells are numbered 1-4 and mostly independent except for the shared EXPO CTRL line (drives all four gains together) and the Q VCA's connection to OUT4.

typical_application: Classic analog-synth voltage-controlled filter (VCF) core: wire one to four cells for low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch, all-pass, or state-variable responses. Direct successor to the SSM2040, widely used in Eurorack VCF modules and other DIY/boutique synth builds.
gotchas: split supply only, minimum +-4V; will not run from a single rail
EXPO CTRL sets the gain of all four cells together; there is no per-cell independent gain control other than external circuitry
OUT pins are buffered but still limited to +-1V swing and need 10k ohm or greater feedback/load resistors; driving them into a low impedance will not work as expected
Q VCA's inverting input is internally hardwired to OUT4, not user-accessible; the resonance feedback path assumes a specific topology (see the datasheet's application circuits)
pin/electrical successor to the SSM2040 but not a spec-for-spec clone: typical gm is 215uS vs the SSM2040's 200uS, with tighter production spread (1.7:1 vs 3:1)
sold only directly by Sound Semiconductor and its authorized resellers, not a general second-sourced part
